---
name: Scientific or numerical defect
about: Track a reproducible numerical or scientific discrepancy
title: "[SCIENCE] "
labels: bug
---

## Identity

Commit, model/algorithm/version, environment and affected public interface:

## Preconditions and reproduction

Minimal non-sensitive inputs, units/normalization, tolerances, branch, grid and seed:

## Independent expectation

Analytic/manufactured/reference relation, provenance and expected residual/error:

## Actual behavior

Value, residual/error, convergence/iteration history and termination reason:

## Risk and boundaries

Validity assumptions, affected consumers, severity and architectural ownership:

## Regression and disposition

Failing regression, smallest repair, compatibility impact, V&V and owner approval:

Numerical convergence is not physical/experimental validation. Do not upload restricted data.
